payload.title: File:Anthracosuchus balrogus skeletal.png
payload.description_html: Anthracosuchus balrogus was a basal, blunt snouted dyrosaurid from the Paleocene Cerrejon Formation of Colombia. The dark grey areas represent bone fragments and a missplaced vertebrae (largest of the pieces) that were found on the skull. It's furthermore set apart by its very whidely spaced orbits. Scalebar = 20 cm, the grid is 10x10 cm https://www.researchgate.net/publication/262764165_A_new_blunt-snouted_dyrosaurid_Anthracosuchus_balrogus_gen_et_sp_nov_Crocodylomorpha_Mesoeucrocodylia_from_the_Palaeocene_of_Colombia
